body:
WHAT
At the end of a turn that changed runnable source files (judged by file suffix, e.g. .ts/.py/.go; docs and config do not count) and executed no Bash command at all, the harness injects one user-role reminder naming the changed files and asking the model to prove the change by running it: fast gate first, then the changed path and callers, a throwaway harness in the system temp dir deleted the same turn, judged on exit codes/stdout/logs. It fires at most once per turn, is deterministic, and never blocks the turn from ending afterwards. A command that ran and failed still counts as having run.

WHY
A change that was only reasoned about looks exactly like a verified one; without the floor the turn can end on code nobody has observed working.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/finishing.ts — CODE_FILE_EXTENSIONS, codeFilesAmong(paths), RUNTIME_EVIDENCE prompt (id finishing.runtime-evidence), VISION_ON/VISION_OFF, fileList() (MAX_NAMED_FILES = 8), runtimeEvidenceText(). Fired from engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — Session.observeTurnWork() (filesChangedThisTurn from successful Write/Edit, ranCommandThisTurn from any Bash), the `nothingRan` branch in runTurn() with the `evidenceNudgeFired` fuse reset at turn start.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. codeFilesAmong(['a.ts','README.md','package.json','b.py']) returns ['a.ts','b.py'].
2. runtimeEvidenceText(['a.ts','b.ts'], false) names both files, contains 'did not run a single command', the numbered steps 1–5, and the VISION_OFF clause; with vision=true it contains the VISION_ON clause; with 10 files it names 8 and says 'and 2 more'.
3. FakeProvider script: Write src/a.ts (success) then end_turn → the session emits command_output '↻ nothing was run — verifying the change for real' and pushes exactly one user message containing 'You changed code this turn (src/a.ts)'; a second end_turn afterwards ends the turn with no further evidence reminder.
4. FakeProvider script: Write src/a.ts, then Bash `exit 1` (nonzero), then end_turn → no evidence reminder is pushed (a failed command still counts as an observation).
5. FakeProvider script: Write docs/notes.md only, then end_turn → no reminder; and a Write that returned isError (e.g. refused freshness) does not add the file to filesChangedThisTurn so no reminder fires.
